name: thrixel
description: Build playable 3D games with AI-generated assets. The build-world skill carries you from an idea to a finished, playable game in Three.js, Unity, Unreal or Roblox, and sets up the Thrixel connector that generates, refines and textures the game-ready .glb models.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into a playable 3D game. Generates, refines and textures game-ready .glb assets, then builds the game around them in Three.js, Unity, Unreal or Roblox.
interface.longDescription: Build World takes a one-line game idea to something you can actually play. It settles what you are making, generates the 3D assets with Thrixel, then writes the game around them: scene, controls, UI, mobile input, and a build it plays through and checks before handing back. Three.js, Unity, Unreal and Roblox are supported. The first run sets up a Thrixel account and the connector that generates the assets; models come back as .glb you own and can keep using anywhere.
defaultPrompt: Build a submarine exploration game in three.js set in a bright, vibrant tropical sea with coral and fish.
Build a fantasy RPG in three.js set in a misty mountain village with timber houses, a shrine and villagers to talk to.
Build an explorable 3D solar system in three.js you can fly through, with labelled planets, moons and orbits to scale.
